card.name: State word after keep or stay
card.fires_on: The word that completes a state after 'keep', 'stay' or 'remain', such as 'keep teachers informed', 'staying asleep' or 'remain in motion'. It is general web text, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Keep someone informed
modes.description: A participle or adjective follows 'keep' plus a person.
modes.example: This means that parents keep teachers<< informed>> about important events in their child's home

modes.label: Stay or remain in a state
modes.description: A state word follows 'stay', 'staying' or 'remain in'.
modes.example: Nearly everyone, at sometime in life, has trouble falling asleep or staying<< asleep>>, a condition known as insomnia.

card.plain: It fires on the word that says what state someone or something is kept in, like informed, asleep or in motion.
